title: 第9章 师尊的命令是绝对的第10章 大胆逆徒居然连为师的嘴子都想吃
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“大师兄牛吊，我从来没有见过这么厉害的男人！”
“我宣布，从今天开始，大师兄在我心里就是男人中的男人！”
一位女弟子看着江尘羽的背影，不由得倒吸了好几口凉气。
她之前就知道大师兄很顶，但没有想到居然这么能顶。
只不过是略微一出手，就将隔壁宗的大师姐熊都给扎穿！
并且，听隔壁大师姐的说法，这还是她们大师兄手下留情的情况下。
要是动起真格来，那估摸着隔壁大师姐的熊就不是被扎穿，而是直接炸飞了！
“太好了，是大师兄，我们男修有救了！”
看着江尘羽那宽厚中又带着几丝宏伟的背影，不少男修的双眼都开始泛着热泪。
多少年了！
他们男修当中已经不知多少年没有出过能够稳压同一个世代的天才了！
耳边传来众人的欢呼与雀跃，江尘羽倒是没有太过喜悦。
毕竟，他此时仅仅只继承了江魔头七成左右的实力。
还有三成左右，还需要他慢慢地将记忆消化以及进行实战训练之后才可重新拾起。
‘不过，我比魔头好的一点是我对于天魔之体的控制要来得好上不少！’
‘在支线中，虽然我也是强势镇压风灵云，却流露出了一股魔气，但是现在的我别说流露魔气，浑身流淌的都是正气啊！’
‘现在萧三火要是敢说我是魔头，我甚至能够反污蔑他是魔教卧底！’
这般思考着，江尘羽顿时觉得自己的未来也没有想象中的那么黑暗。
他只需要默默地苟着，然后把盯上自己的主角们给一一消灭就行了！
......

回到了房间之中，江尘羽看着眼前跪伏在自己身前，满眼都是炽热之色的李鸾凤陷入了沉默。
‘这也太能cpu了吧！
居然把这样一个好端端的天才整成自己的忠心舔狗！’
“你是说，你只花了一个月的时间便攻破了一个秘境，还替为师带来了一部名为《大荒造化经》的神秘功法？”
他摸了摸下巴，神色间浮现起一抹喜悦之色。
要是论功法的等阶，《大荒造化经》的等级绝对是排在第一流的。
虽然是一部炼体功法，与主流的修仙体系不符，但功法所需要消耗的资源确实不多，算是非常有性价比的功法。
在玩游戏的时候，他一般都会尝试将这部功法收入囊中。
毕竟，有没有这部功法的游玩体验差距还是非常之大的，也算是给玩家的官方福利了！
“是的！”
“对不起，弟子回来晚了。
弟子明明跟师尊说要在一月之内返回宗门的，但弟子在踏进宗门的时候已经过去了一月零一天零二时了！”
“对此，弟子感到十分惭愧，还请师尊责罚！”
说完，她的脑袋“哐哐”地在地上磕了几下，白皙的额头也因此染上些许妖冶的红色。
显然这妮子在磕头的时候没有丝毫保留。
若非是这地板的强度不够，不然她的脑袋绝对已经鲜血淋漓了！
“责罚就免了吧。
content_en:
"Elder brother Niudiao, I have never seen such a powerful man!"
"I declare that from today on, Senior Brother is the man among men in my heart!"
A female disciple looked at Jiang Chenyu's back and couldn't help but gasped several times.
She knew that her senior brother was very popular before, but she didn't expect that he could be so powerful.
With just one move, he pierced the eldest sister Xiongdu of the next door sect!
Moreover, according to what the senior sister next door said, this was under the condition that their senior brother showed mercy.
If it were serious, I guess the bear next door to the senior sister would not be pierced, but blown up!
"Great, it's Senior Brother, our male cultivators are saved!"
Looking at Jiang Chenyu's generous and majestic back, many male cultivators began to shed tears in their eyes.
How many years!
Among their male cultivators, there has been no genius who can stabilize the same generation for countless years!
Hearing the cheers and excitement of everyone, Jiang Chenyu was not too happy.
After all, he had only inherited about 70% of Demon Jiang's strength at this time.
There is still about 30% left, and he still needs to slowly digest the memory and conduct actual combat training before he can pick it up again.
'However, one thing I am better than the devil is that I have much better control over the body of the devil! ’
‘In the branch plot, although I also suppressed Feng Lingyun strongly, I showed a demonic energy. But now, let alone revealing the demonic aura, I am full of righteous energy! ’
‘Now if Xiao Sanhuo dares to say that I am a demon, I can even accuse him of being an undercover agent of the demon sect! ’
Thinking like this, Jiang Chenyu suddenly felt that his future was not as dark as he imagined.
He just needs to endure silently, and then eliminate the protagonists who are targeting him one by one!
...
After returning to the room, Jiang Chenyu fell silent as he looked at Li Luanfeng, who was kneeling in front of him, his eyes full of blazing color.
‘This is too powerful for the CPU!
He actually turned such a good-natured genius into his loyal licking dog! ’
"You mean, it only took you a month to break through a secret realm, and you also brought a mysterious technique called "The Great Wilderness Sutra" to my master?"
He touched his chin, a look of joy appearing on his face.
If we talk about the level of skills, the level of "Great Wilderness Creation Sutra" is definitely ranked first.
Although it is a physical training method that is not in line with the mainstream system of cultivating immortals, it does not consume many resources and is considered a very cost-effective method.
When playing games, he usually tries to incorporate this technique into his pocket.
After all, there is still a huge gap in gaming experience with or without this technique, and it can be considered an official benefit for players!
"Yes!"
"I'm sorry, disciple, I came back late.
The disciple clearly told the master that he would return to the sect within one month, but when the disciple stepped into the sect, it had already been one month, one day and two hours! "
"Disciple feels very ashamed about this and asks Master to punish me!"
After saying that, her head banged on the ground a few times, and her fair forehead was dyed a bit of coquettish red.
It was obvious that this girl had no reservations when kowtowing.
If the floor wasn't strong enough, her head would definitely be dripping with blood!
"The punishment will be waived.
